title: erbyu's Happier Ghasts
description: Slightly changes Happy Ghasts to look happier.
body:
erbyu's Happier Ghasts

Think the Happy Ghast doesn't look happy enough? You want a bigger smile? It's not just you. Here's a resource pack that slightly modifies the Happy Ghast's texture to be just a little bit happier.

Dependencies

Entity Model Features — Optional. Makes the gills look more accurate to the Ghastling's.

See also

The Gillless version — The same resource pack, but without gills.
